metadata.title: Fyxio — Premium Business Websites, Built Fast
metadata.description: Premium business websites for companies that want better than "just okay." Custom builds, redesigns, and WordPress migrations.

sections.heroSubtitle: For businesses that want a site that looks stronger, feels more current, and is easier to manage — without the usual 6-week agency timeline.

sections.title: Your website ready in
sections.body: Most agencies take 6–12 weeks. I work in focused sprints — one project at a time, no context switching, no internal handoffs. The result is faster delivery without cutting corners on quality.

items.title: Custom website builds
items.desc: For businesses that want a modern website built from scratch — not a template with a logo swap. Designed around your business, your offer, and the way you want to be seen.

items.title: Full website redesigns
items.desc: For companies with a website that no longer feels good enough. Rethink the structure, messaging, visuals, and editing setup — then rebuild into something that actually supports the business.

items.title: AI Build Sessions
items.desc: A focused hands-on session where I set up Claude Code or Codex in your project and teach you how to make real changes yourself — to your site or anything you want to build.

items.title: Custom AI workflows
items.desc: I help identify manual, repetitive, or high-value workflows and build practical AI-assisted solutions around them — content systems, internal tools, automation flows, document workflows.

steps.title: Materials & direction
steps.text: You send the essentials — texts, images, logo files, references, and any direction. The clearer the materials, the faster everything moves.

steps.title: First draft build
steps.text: Once materials are in, I build the real site — not a mockup, not a long design phase. Usually done in 1–2 days.

steps.title: One refinement round
steps.text: You review the draft and give one focused round of feedback. I refine based on that. No endless revision loops.

steps.title: Launch & handover
steps.text: Site goes live, everything is verified, and you get full ownership of the code, domain, and hosting setup.

sections.title: Built for businesses
sections.caseStudyDesc: Premium website, clean structure, credible design, full launch setup. Delivered in 3 days.

sections.ctaSub: Send me your brief and materials. The faster you move, the faster it goes live.
